title: Lab - Manage containers and VMs
description: Run a container with a volume and a port, and bring up a VM.
scenario: Run a container with a volume and a port, and bring up a VM. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Container
tasks.instructions: Run nginx detached, publishing port 8080 and mounting /opt/web at the web root.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Inspect
tasks.instructions: Read its logs and find the container IP.
tasks.solution:
docker logs web
docker inspect -f '{{.NetworkSettings.IPAddress}}' web

tasks.title: Task 3 - VM
tasks.instructions: Define and start a VM from a cloud image with virt-install, then list running domains.
